text:
[issue by Brixxii]
### Minecraft Version

1.21

### Mod Loader

Fabric

### Mod Loader Version

0.15.11

### Mod Version

21.0.7

### Balm Version

21.0.11

### Describe the Issue

Able to place down waystones but the menu does not recognize new ones added, the screen remains blank. Clicking the next button causes the whole game to save and crash. 

### Logs

https://pastebin.com/iqXHhcrX

### Do you use any performance-enhancing mods (e.g. OptiFine) or custom server distributions (e.g. SpongeForge)?

_No response_

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Your warpRequirements config option seems to be invalid. The next version should no longer crash in that case, but you should still consider fixing/resetting it.
